text:
anya: heads up — experiment idea: add a snapshot catalog debounce and a deferred-verify path for safetensors to cut warmup spikes.

sanjay: can you sketch the flow? how does deferred verify interact with fallbacks?

anya: quick sketch — on bundle publish we register a snapshot id in catalog; serving nodes get the id and start a best-effort streaming load. verify (checksum + signature) runs async and may be delayed if IO is contended. If verification fails later, we evict and fallback to a compatible older snapshot.

kevin: sounds like optimistic load. risk: we may start serving partial shards before full integrity checks complete. how do we avoid corrupt outputs?

anya: plan is to differentiate data plane vs control plane verification. Data plane allows read-only streaming for non-critical layers (embedding table primes, rotary caches). Critical weights (attention/qkv/bias) are pinned until verified. heuristics: verify critical segment headers synchronously; async verify the bulk tensor payloads.

kevin: ok. need a clear API surface for loader adapters. Something like: `load_snapshot(snapshot_id, mode="deferred_verify")` that returns a handle with `is_verified` flag and `on_verify` callback.

anya: exactly. proto:
```
handle = loader.load_snapshot(id, mode="deferred_verify")
if not handle.is_verified and model.needs_strict: loader.pin_critical(handle, critical_ranges)
handle.on_verify(lambda result: metrics.emit("snapshot.verify", result))
```

sanjay: metrics and observability are important — we should emit time-to-verify and number of served tokens while unverified. ops will want alarm if unverified-serving > X tokens/min.

kevin: also need eviction semantics: if verify fails, we should support an atomic swap to fallback model (same input ABI). But what about in-flight KV cache pointers referencing evicted memory? we need a handoff contract.

anya: proposal: warmup coordinator maintains per-request token-level routing: unverified loads get a prefix-safe mode (no KV-cache population for layers we might evict). Once verified, we enable full KV populate for subsequent requests. That avoids dangling refs.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rolled out canary with deferred-verify=true for model-qa namespace at 03:00 UTC.

kevin: good. one more tradeoff: storage cost + IO — deferred verify means we may keep multiple snapshots longer. we should add a catalog debounce policy: batch publishes over short window (30s) and coalesce identical manifests to avoid thrash.

anya: agreed. debounce window configurable per-namespace. default 30s, enterprise customers can tune. also add `deferred_verify_ttl` before we force synchronous verify on long-unverified loads.

sanjay: sounds reasonable. need an RFC doc for loader API + warmup coordinator changes. also add test plan: sim fault injection where verify fails after 10s and ensure fallback correctness and no invalid outputs.

kevin: can you start the RFC draft? I'll drop pseudo-API and tests.

anya: will do. creating RFC draft in docs repo and a short spike to measure additional memory footprint. thanks all :white_check_mark:
